memory_verse: "He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit." —Romans 8:11, NASB
sermon_title: A Freedom Only Christ Can Give

days.focus: The Outside of the Cup vs. the Inside
days.reflection_question: If God were to tip your cup over right now and expose what has been on the inside this past week — your private thoughts, motives, and attitudes that no one else has seen — would you be satisfied with what He found, or have you been more concerned with maintaining a clean exterior before people than a clean interior before Him? Name one specific thing on the inside that you have been hiding behind a good external testimony.

days.focus: God Looks at the Heart — Walking in the Fear of God
days.reflection_question: Knowing that God sees your heart 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — including Monday through Saturday when no one from church is watching — is the way you think, speak, and react at home or at work something you would be comfortable with if Jesus were visibly sitting in the same room? What specific attitude or habit do you live with privately that you would immediately change if you truly believed God was watching and evaluating it?

days.focus: Captive to Inner Sin — and the Freedom Jesus Came to Proclaim
days.reflection_question: Jesus said He came to proclaim release to the captives — people who had a good external religious testimony but were inwardly bound by envy, pride, bitterness, and lust. Which specific sin do you keep returning to week after week, sitting in church on Sunday while carrying it? Have you truly brought that captivity before Jesus and asked for real release from its power, or have you only asked for forgiveness of the guilt while accepting continued bondage to it as normal?

days.focus: Do You Wish to Be Well? — Honest Desire for Real Change
days.reflection_question: The man at Bethesda had been trying and failing for 38 years before Jesus asked him, 'Do you wish to be well?' Jesus is not asking whether you can fix yourself — He is asking whether you genuinely want to be free, or whether you have quietly settled for your present spiritual condition because change feels impossible. Is there a pattern of inner sin — anger, anxiety, lust, unforgiveness — that you have stopped truly fighting because you have given up hope? Bring that specific thing before God today and answer His question honestly.

days.focus: The Spirit Who Gives Life to Your Mortal Body — Real Transformation, Not Just Doctrine
days.reflection_question: Romans 8:11 promises that the very Spirit who raised Christ from the dead lives in you and gives life to your mortal body — meaning your actual daily body with its tempers, cravings, fears, and selfish impulses. Are you practically relying on the Holy Spirit throughout each ordinary moment of your day, or do you treat Him as a theological fact you believe while actually navigating daily attitudes and reactions in your own strength? Think of one recurring moment in a typical day — a frustration, a temptation, a moment of pride — and ask yourself: what would it look like to consciously yield to the Spirit's life in that exact moment rather than reacting from the flesh?

days.focus: Freedom That Only Christ Can Give — Living for God's Opinion, Not People's
days.reflection_question: Acts 13:39 says that through Jesus, everyone who believes is freed from all things from which the law of Moses could not free them — meaning real inward freedom, not just an improved external record. As you review this week, have you made any actual choices — in a quiet moment, in your thought life, in a relationship — where you chose what God sees over what people see? And where you did not: what was the root fear or desire that made other people's opinion feel more real to you than God's? Write it down and bring it to God before Sunday, asking Him not just to forgive it but to free you from it.
